November 19, 2026


Day 2 of CNA West saw Cameco leaders sharing insights and perspectives focused on the future of nuclear energy in Western Canada. A big thank you to everyone who joined sessions featuring our CEO Tim Gitzel, President and Chief Operating Officer Grant Isaac, senior VPs Lisa Aitken and Liam Mooney, board member and Lac La Ronge Chief Tammy Cook-Searson and Senior Director Kari Krueckl Lamont. We're also proud to be the presenting sponsor of tonight's Indigenous Ambassador Reception, bringing people together to connect, learn and strengthen relationships across our industry. Two down, one to go. Stay tuned for highlights of tomorrow's final day! #CNAWEST2026[#NuclearEnergy](https://facebook.com/hashtag/NuclearEnergy) #Calgary
